body.name: \((\widehat\tau_{C,n},\widehat V_{C,n})\)
body.construction:
For one fixed certified input on case (iii) of \(\operatorname{SparseSIM\text{-}ID}\), fix a returned quotient class \(C\) and its canonical representative \(R_C\).  Define
\[
 \tau_C(p)=\bigl(T_{R_C,y}(p)\bigr)_y.
\]
On the event \(\min_yB_{R_C,y}(\widehat p_n)>0\), set
\[
 \widehat\tau_{C,n}=\tau_C(\widehat p_n),
 \qquad
 \widehat\Sigma_n=\operatorname{diag}(\widehat p_n)-\widehat p_n\widehat p_n^{\mathsf T},
\]
and
\[
 \widehat V_{C,n}
 =J_{\tau_C}(\widehat p_n)\widehat\Sigma_n
 J_{\tau_C}(\widehat p_n)^{\mathsf T}.
\]
Set \(\widehat\tau_{C,n}=0\) and \(\widehat V_{C,n}=0\) off that event.  The input, exact oracle, quotient class, and representative circuit are fixed before observing the inference sample, or are externally certified true objects independent of that sample.
